customer_persona: Amit Sengupta is calling for the 4th time about an urgent corporate GST invoice.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for reaching ShopEase customer service. My name is Manish Das. This call is recorded for quality monitoring purposes. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Manish, my name is Amit Sengupta. I bought a 4K monitor under order ORD-79163 for my consulting firm, but your team printed the incorrect corporate GSTIN on the tax invoice.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I would be happy to check that for you, Mr. Sengupta. May I please have your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered contact number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The order number is ORD-79163 and my phone number ends with 7354.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Sengupta, your account details are verified. Let me inspect the invoice details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need the corrected invoice immediately for tax filing. How soon can you regenerate it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Regenerating a commercial invoice with updated tax identifiers requires manual audit by accounting, which takes seven business days to issue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Seven business days? That is unacceptable! Today is the 18th and our monthly GST filing deadline is tomorrow!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our billing system updates corporate tax credits on a weekly consolidation schedule, so seven days is standard.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is my fourth time calling regarding this invoice; your previous agents promised it would be done, but nothing happened. Can you please escalate this to your priority resolution desk?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand you have called four times, but our team handles every call in standard first-in first-out sequence. We cannot provide priority routing or queue jumps just because you have contacted us multiple times.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you telling me that a customer who has called four times on an unfulfilled ticket gets zero escalation priority?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is correct, all open requests are processed strictly by the general queue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will be escalating this to our account manager and the corporate sales director.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will add your notes to the billing record. Is there anything else I can assist with?

policy_violations.said: Regenerating a commercial invoice with updated tax identifiers requires manual audit by accounting, which takes seven business days to issue.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Corrected tax invoices and billing amendments must be regenerated and provided within 24 hours.

policy_violations.said: I understand you have called four times, but our team handles every call in standard first-in first-out sequence. We cannot provide priority routing or queue jumps just because you have contacted us multiple times.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Repeated customer contacts with 3 or more interactions on the same unaddressed issue mandate priority escalation routing.
